mechanism_narrative: Because WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, weekday out-of-home trip generation stays weak and retail visitation should remain below the prior four-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages above its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying below -15 and TRANSIT staying below -20 for most weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run rebound in PARKS from negative to positive weekly change diverts discretionary time away from malls and dining, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the following one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses from negative to positive week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -15.6 at t-3w to 2.3 at t-2w before falling back
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises relative to its prior week after PARKS turns positive and remains at least 5 points above its own prior-week level.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM improves while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, households consolidate errands and reduce nonessential retail trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM is less negative than the prior two-week average and RESIDENTIAL stays above +8.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls further below its already weak level, access to retail corridors tightens and retail-and-recreation mobility declines over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT drops below -30 after having been above -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower than its last-four-week mean after TRANSIT moves below -30 and remains there for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals broader circulation and commuting, which should translate into higher retail visits in the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve by at least 3 points from their current levels.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt PARKS spike followed by a return toward baseline indicates weather-driven outdoor substitution that temporarily suppresses indoor shopping demand over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by more than 10 points from the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken in the week after a PARKS jump of more than 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline and GROCERY_PHARM stays only mildly negative, errand bundling and home-centered routines keep retail footfall suppressed for four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its previous four-week mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +8 and GROCERY_PHARM remains between -6 and 0.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stops improving and turns downward while TRANSIT is already flat, the labor-market circulation channel weakens and retail mobility should fall within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES declines below its prior-week value after a period of improvement
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -23.9 to -20.9 and then stayed near -20.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days even though WORKPLACES reverses downward and TRANSIT does not improve.
